title: Prioritization Scorecard (T06)
subtitle: Score each initiative 1–5 on the weighted criteria, compare value and feasibility, and propose a ranking. All figures come from the server; the weighted score is calculated, never typed.
separation: A ranking is a proposal. Selecting an initiative and funding it are separate business approvals recorded elsewhere.
tooLargeTitle: This portfolio is too large to prioritize on one screen

shared.conflictReloaded: Nothing was saved. Someone changed this record after you loaded it; the latest version has been loaded. Review it and try again.

weights.title: Weight sets
weights.intro: Weights must total exactly 100%. Version 1 is the source default (25/25/20/15/15). A new set is proposed, then approved by someone other than the proposer; approved versions are kept.

basis.source_default: (source default, configured starting point, not a business approval)

weights.noActive: No active weight set: weighted scores are Unknown.
weights.rationaleHint: Why these weights fit this transformation (1 to 4,000 characters).
weights.ownProposal: You proposed this set; another person must approve it.
weights.approveBody: Approving activates these weights and supersedes the active version. Every eligible initiative is rescored; results under earlier versions are kept.
weights.withdrawBody: The proposal is withdrawn and never becomes active. It stays in the version history.
weights.proposeIntro: Include 2 to 6 criteria. Each weight is a percentage above 0 with at most 2 decimals, and the total must be exactly 100%.

ranked.title: Ranked initiatives
ranked.intro: The proposed order under the active weights. Incomplete initiatives are listed after the ranked ones.
ranked.tieBreak: Equal weighted scores are ordered by initiative code.
ranked.caption: Ranked initiatives with weighted score, value, feasibility, selection and funding
ranked.emptyBody: Only submitted, ranked, selected, funded and launched initiatives are prioritized. Change the filters or submit initiatives in the portfolio.

chart.title: Value and feasibility
chart.intro: Value combines financial value and customer impact; feasibility combines feasibility and time-to-value, each weighted by the active set (1–5).
chart.alt: Scatter chart of value against feasibility for {{count}} initiatives. The same data is in the table below.
chart.tableToggle: Show the chart data as a table
chart.unplotted: Not plotted (a needed score is missing, so the axis is Unknown): {{codes}}

scorecard.title: Scorecard
scorecard.intro: Scores are whole numbers from 1 to 5. A missing score makes the weighted score incomplete; it is never counted as 0.
scorecard.choose: Choose an initiative to see and edit its scores.
scorecard.scoreHint: A whole number from 1 to 5; leave empty to clear.
scorecard.readOnly: The weighted score is calculated by the server from the scores and the active weights. It cannot be typed.

rankings.title: Ranking snapshots and history
rankings.intro: A snapshot records the proposed ranking at a point in time and why each position changed.
rankings.createBody: The current proposed ranking is recorded under the active weights. Approved overrides are applied. Nothing is selected or funded.
rankings.noneBody: Record a snapshot to keep the proposed ranking and its history.
rankings.currentCaption: Entries of the current ranking snapshot

overrides.title: Rank overrides
overrides.intro: An override places an initiative at a chosen rank in the next snapshot. It needs a reason and a business approval by someone other than the proposer.
overrides.proposeBody: The override applies from the next ranking snapshot once it is approved.
overrides.reasonHint: Required: 3 to 2,000 characters explaining why the calculated rank is overridden.
overrides.caption: Rank overrides
overrides.ownProposal: You proposed this override; another person must decide it.
overrides.revokeBody: The override stops applying from the next ranking snapshot.

problem.prioritization__weight_format: Enter the weight as a percentage with at most 2 decimals.
problem.prioritization__weight_range: A weight must be above 0% and at most 100%. Leave a criterion out instead of giving it 0.
problem.prioritization__unknown_criterion: This criterion is not part of the scorecard.
problem.prioritization__criteria_count: A weight set has 2 to 6 criteria.
problem.prioritization__score_range: Enter a whole number from 1 to 5.
problem.prioritization__score_exists: This criterion was scored meanwhile. The latest scores have been loaded; try again.
problem.prioritization__weight_set_not_proposed: Only a proposed weight set can be approved or withdrawn.
problem.prioritization__override_not_proposed: Only a proposed override can be approved or rejected.
problem.prioritization__override_not_revocable: Only an approved override can be revoked.
problem.prioritization__override_exists: This initiative already has a proposed or approved override. Decide or revoke it first.
problem.prioritization__override_not_eligible: Only an initiative in the portfolio (submitted or later, not cancelled) can be given a rank override.
problem.prioritization__override_rank: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
problem.prioritization__on_behalf_not_supported: This business approval is decided in person; deciding on someone's behalf is not available.
problem.prioritization__portfolio_too_large: The prioritization view covers at most 500 initiatives. Narrow the portfolio before prioritizing.
problem.approval__approver_is_proposer: The person who proposed this cannot approve it (separation of duties).
